name: Basil
description: A soft, bright-green herb with a sweet, peppery smell. It loves warmth and is the heart of Italian summer cooking.

image.alt: A pot of fresh green basil leaves

uses.title: Kitchen
uses.text: Pesto, tomato salads, pizza and pasta.

uses.title: Raw
uses.text: Add the leaves at the end; heat dulls the flavour.

uses.title: Garden
uses.text: Grow it next to tomatoes in a sunny spot.

growingTips.title: Sun
growingTips.text: It needs warmth: plant it outside only after the last frost.

growingTips.title: Water
growingTips.text: Keep the soil slightly moist and water at the base, not on the leaves.

growingTips.title: Pinching
growingTips.text: Pinch off flower buds so the plant keeps making leaves.

growingTips.title: Harvest
growingTips.text: Pick leaves from the top, just above a pair of leaves, so it grows bushy.
